summary: Comprehensive testing of Order Ticket Printing (Thermal Printer) feature - Iteration 17. Backend: 22/22 pytest tests pass (1 skipped because no pending+paid orders exist in DB). Frontend: all required admin pages, ticket pages, customer receipt flows render with correct data-testids; auto=1 triggers window.print on receipt + admin ticket pages.

minor.issue: Legacy/default print_settings docs created before auto_receipt field don't include auto_receipt key on GET until first PATCH — test now primes via PATCH, but a GET-before-any-write in production would miss the field. Low risk; defaults merged is cleaner (spread DEFAULT_PRINT_SETTINGS over DB doc in _get_print_settings).

integration_issues.issue: Button is implemented in JSX (data-testid='print-receipt-btn') but only renders after Stripe session polling returns payment_status='paid'. Navigating directly with only ?order_id= leaves the page in loading/error state, so the button is not visible in our direct-URL test. Code inspection confirms the button exists at line 227 of OrderSuccessPage.js and links to /receipt/:id with target=_blank. This is expected gating, not a bug — but end-to-end proof requires a real Stripe checkout success redirect or a session_id parameter whose status endpoint returns paid. Recommend main agent verify by completing a checkout in preview.

action_items: (Optional) In _get_print_settings, merge DEFAULT_PRINT_SETTINGS over the DB doc so legacy records always return auto_receipt/auto_trigger keys without a write.
Main agent to spot-check OrderSuccessPage print-receipt-btn after a real Stripe success redirect (functional code is present; only Stripe-gated rendering prevents direct-URL verification).
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now 2196 lines — consider splitting printers/KDS modules into separate routers for maintainability.

_auto_queue_for_order swallows exceptions with only a warning log; acceptable for non-critical side effect, but for on_placement the caller (payment_status) completes normally even if queueing crashes (good).

Public /api/orders/{id}/receipt returns the entire order doc (including customer contact, totals, items). This is correct for a receipt, but note it leaks order details if someone guesses/enumerates order IDs — order IDs are UUIDv4 so enumeration is impractical; acceptable.
PrinterPatchBody allows station to be set to any free-form string; front-end lists known stations. No server-side enum validation; minor hardening opportunity.
test_print logs a job with ticket_type='test' — nice, allowed through print history.

success_rate.backend: 100% (22 passed, 1 skipped — no pending+paid orders available for auto-queue-on-acceptance e2e)
success_rate.frontend: 95% (all admin printer pages, ticket pages, receipt page, tracking, customer orders history confirmed; OrderSuccess button gated behind Stripe session — code confirmed present)

seed_data_creation: Created multiple TEST_ prefixed printers via API fixtures (auto-cleaned via fixture teardown). No permanent seed data.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Printer feature is solid. Backend tests live at /app/backend/tests/test_printers.py (22 pass, 1 skipped). Admin pages: /admin/printers, /admin/print-settings, /admin/print-jobs, /admin/orders all render with required data-testids. Ticket pages: /admin/ticket/:order_id?type=kitchen|receipt and public /receipt/:order_id both work; ?auto=1 triggers window.print() on both. Customer /orders history shows per-order print-receipt-btn-<orderNumber>. /orders/track/:order_id shows tracking-print-receipt-btn. OrderSuccessPage button is in source but only visible post-Stripe-success — not easily reachable via direct URL. Admin sidebar has Printers / Print Settings / Print History. For next iteration, to prove auto-queue-on-acceptance end-to-end, seed a pending+paid order via DB or place a fresh order via checkout so /api/admin/orders/new has data.

mocked_apis_list: Thermal printer hardware — simulated via browser window.print() only
